title: Phases of a guess-and-run machine
statement: The guess-and-run phase type consists of six phases: deterministic setup, bounded choice writing, a step to the right past the blank after the guessed block, rewinding the writer's tape to the block's start, a deterministic run up to a live verdict, and verdict emission.
